modes.name: Shiyu Defense: Critical Node
sharedMechanics: In this stage, dealing DMG to enemies earns you DMG Score. Defeating a single normal/elite enemy will grant you an instance of Elimination Score.
In this stage, scores earned at different times will receive additional multiplier bonuses. The earlier in the challenge, the higher the multiplier. The total score cap (including bonus) is 50,000.

bosses.name: Tepes
mechanics: Agent Ether DMG and Ice DMG increase by 35%, while their CRIT DMG increases by 25%.
When an Agent with Attack specialty hits a Stunned enemy, enemy DEF drops by 25% for 5s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

bosses.name: Autonomous Assault Unit - Airspace Sentinel
mechanics: If there are 2/3 Agents with the Anomaly specialty in the squad, Attribute Anomaly DMG dealt by Agents increases by 10%/60%, and the whole squad initially gains 500/1,500 Decibels upon entering combat.

bosses.name: Lockspring (Boss)
mechanics: Agent DEF increases by 15%, and attacks against enemies ignore 20% of their Electric RES.
After an Agent uses EX Special Attack, their CRIT Rate increases by 5% and CRIT DMG increases by 20% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

enemies.name: Autonomous Support Unit - Lightfoot Rover MK II

selectableBuffs.name: Sharp Rupture
selectableBuffs.description: Agent PEN Ratio increases by 5%. When an attack hits an enemy, it ignores 15% of the target's Electric RES. · After an Agent uses an EX Special Attack or Special Attack, Sharp DMG increases by 20% and DEF increases by 10% for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

selectableBuffs.name: Cinders of Corrosion
selectableBuffs.description: If there are 2/3 Agents in the squad with the Anomaly specialty, the whole squad's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 20/60 respectively, and Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 10%/20% respectively. · After an Agent inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, the enemy's DEF is reduced by 10% for 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

selectableBuffs.name: Gleaming Frost
selectableBuffs.description: Agents with the Attack specialty deal 20% more Ice DMG. · Agent CRIT DMG increases by 30%. When attacking a Stunned enemy, the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier additionally increases by 20% for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

bosses.name: Kusarikku
mechanics: Attribute Anomaly DMG taken by Kusarikku is reduced by 40%.

When an Agent successfully uses a Defensive Assist against Kusarikku's Rift Assault, applies 1 stack of Exposed to Kusarikku. When Kusarikku becomes Stunned, applies 2 stacks of Exposed. Each stack of Exposed increases the Laceration DMG Kusarikku receives by 10%. Exposed can stack up to 4 times and lasts 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

After Kusarikku activates Corruptive Barrier, use Defensive Assist to counter Kusarikku's Rift Assault and leave it Impaired to gain 1000 Performance Points; successfully countering a Rift Assault with Defensive Assist grants 700 Performance Points; executing a Shutdown on Kusarikku's Control Skill grants 2000 Performance Points. A maximum of 5000 Performance Points can be obtained.
Suitable for Agents with Armorer specialty.
objectives: 1 étoile — Reach 6,000 points within the time limit
2 étoiles — Reach 14,000 points within the time limit
3 étoiles — Reach 20,000 points within the time limit

bosses.name: Girtablullu - Stagnant Aberrant
mechanics: When an Agent inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, the target enemy gains 1 stack of Blight Mark of the corresponding attribute, lasting 30s and stacking up to 2 times. Repeated triggers of same-attribute Blight Mark reset its duration.
For every stack of Blight Mark inflicted, the enemies take 8% more Attribute Anomaly DMG, and DMG taken by Corruptive Barrier increases by 8%.
When inflicting Impaired or Shutdown on an enemy, the whole squad's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 60 pts, lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

Successfully inflicting Impaired grants 1000 Performance Points; successfully countering Control Skill grants 500 Performance Points each time; preventing an enemy's Corruptive Barrier from completing its charge and rendering them Impaired grants 1,500 Performance Points. During the Control Skill, when triggering Shutdown via Counter Assist, obtain the remaining Performance Points available from the current Control Skill. Maximum obtainable Performance Points: 5,000.
Suitable for Agents with Anomaly specialty.
objectives: 1 étoile — Reach 6,000 points within the time limit
2 étoiles — Reach 14,000 points within the time limit
3 étoiles — Reach 20,000 points within the time limit

bosses.name: Ye Shiyuan the Thrall
mechanics: When Sobek and The Thrall alternate turns, The Thrall gains 1 stack of Contract and Self-Sacrifice. Contract and Self-Sacrifice can stack up to 3 times. Each stack of Contract increases All-Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES by 15%, each stack of Self-Sacrifice increases The Thrall's Stun DMG Multiplier by 10%. When The Thrall is Stunned, CRIT DMG taken increases by 50%.

When Agents inflict Weakened on Sobek and The Thrall, 1,500 Performance Points will be awarded. When an Agent eliminates Sobek, 2,000 Performance Points will be awarded. Up to a maximum of 5,000 Performance Points can be earned.
Suitable for Agents with Stun specialty.
objectives: 1 étoile — Reach 6,000 points within the time limit
2 étoiles — Reach 14,000 points within the time limit
3 étoiles — Reach 20,000 points within the time limit

bosses.name: Integrated - Scorched Horizon
mechanics: When Integrated - Scorched Horizon is Impaired or Shutdown, the whole squad's Sharp DMG increases by 40% for 60s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When an Agent's attack hits an enemy that is not Stunned, Daze dealt increases by 15%. While Integrated - Scorched Horizon is Stunned, the Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 20%.

When Integrated - Scorched Horizon is in Misty Veil state, using Defensive Assist to counter Integrated - Scorched Horizon's attack and impair it grants 1500 Performance Points; landing a Shutdown on Integrated - Scorched Horizon's Control Skill grants 2000 Performance Points. A maximum of 5000 Performance Points can be obtained.
objectives: 1 étoile — Reach 10,000 points within the time limit
2 étoiles — Reach 20,000 points within the time limit
3 étoiles — Reach 30,000 points within the time limit
